htn_kidney.title: Advances in Hyperkalemia Management and the Emerging Role of Sodium Zirconium Cyclosilicate.
htn_kidney.authors: Jung J, Juarez S, Koh ES
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于综述研究。核心观点：高钾血症是慢性肾病和心力衰竭患者常见且可能危及生命的并发症。 临床提示：它还代表了最佳使用肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统抑制剂（RAASi）的主要障碍，而肾素-血管紧张素-醛固酮系统抑制剂对于改善心肾结果至关重要。
htn_kidney.abstract: Hyperkalemia is a common and potentially life-threatening complication in patients with chronic kidney disease and heart failure. It also represents a major barrier to the optimal use of renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system inhibitors (RAASi), which are central to improving cardiorenal outcomes. Contemporary guidance, including the 2025 Korean Society of Nephrology Practical Recommendations for the Management of Hypertensive Kidney Disease, emphasizes the maintenance of normokalemia as a key strategy for enabling continuation and optimization of RAASi therapy. Sodium zirconium cyclosilicate (SZC) supports this therapeutic paradigm by enabling rapid potassium reduction and sustained potassium...

portal_hypertension.title: Post Hoc Analysis of a Phase 2 Randomized Trial of Pemafibrate in Metabolic Dysfunction-associated Steatotic Liver Disease: Associations With Platelet Count, Liver Stiffness, and Spleen Volume.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental hepatology
portal_hypertension.authors: Tanigawa R, Loomba R, Eguchi Y
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 118）。核心观点：门静脉高压是代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）的主要并发症。 临床提示：在 PEMA-FL（非酒精性脂肪肝患者的 PEMAfibrate 随机安慰剂对照研究）2 期试验中，这项事后分析检查了 pemafibrate（一种选择性过氧化物酶体）之间的关联
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension is a major complication in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). In the PEMA-FL (PEMAfibrate randomised placebo-controlled study in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease) phase 2 trial, this post hoc analysis examined associations between pemafibrate, a selective peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha modulator, and noninvasive markers related to portal hypertension-related hemodynamic stress, including platelet count, liver stiffness, and spleen volume. This 72-week, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 study enrolled 118 patients with high-risk MASLD, randomized 1:1 to pemafibrate 0.4 mg/day or...

portal_hypertension.title: Prognostication of Liver Disease Patients via the WFUMB 'Rule-of-4' Algorithm Using SSI-2D-SWE-Based Liver Stiffness Measurement.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Sebesta C, Kramer G, Dominik N
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 187）。核心观点：世界医学和生物学超声联合会 (WFUMB) 2024 年指南更新提出了使用 ARFI 肝脏硬度测量 (LSM) 的“4 规则”来对失代偿事件的风险进行分层。 临床提示：该规则在 ≥ 13 kPa 的阈值时识别晚期慢性肝病 (ACLD)，并表明高于 21 kPa 的具有临床意义的门脉高压 (CSPH) 的可能性很高。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The World Federation for Ultrasound in Medicine and Biology (WFUMB) guidance update 2024 proposed a 'rule-of-4' using ARFI liver stiffness measurement (LSM) to stratify the risk of decompensation events. This rule identifies advanced chronic liver disease (ACLD) at a threshold of ≥ 13 kPa and indicates a high probability of clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH) above 21 kPa. We prospectively enrolled 187 patients undergoing same-day SSI-2D-LSM (Aixplorer SuperSonic Imagine) and hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) measurement. Patients were stratified into three LSM groups < 13 kPa, 13-21 kPa and > 21 kPa and followed for decompensation events for 1 year (Y1). The cohort compr...

portal_hypertension.title: Bleeding ileal conduit varices in a postoperative patient of urinary bladder carcinoma: percutaneous transhepatic variceal embolization to the rescue.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sahoo B, Nayak MK, Ygl K
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：回肠导管是肌层浸​​润性膀胱癌最常进行的尿流改道手术之一，在各种并发症中，回肠导管出血很少见。 临床提示：对于复发性造口出血的患者，必须考虑非典型静脉曲张的可能性，如果之前未确诊，则必须评估是否患有肝硬化。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The ileal conduit is one of the most commonly performed urinary diversion procedures for muscle-invasive bladder cancer, and among the various complications, bleeding from an ileal conduit is rare. In patients with recurrent stomal haemorrhage, one must consider the possibility of atypical varices and assess for liver cirrhosis if it has not been previously established. Here, we describe a case of bleeding ectopic varices at the ileal conduit site in a patient in his 50s who underwent surgery for urinary bladder carcinoma, which was successfully managed through percutaneous transhepatic glue embolisation. Selective embolisation of these ectopic varices with coils or glue produces impressive ...

portal_hypertension.title: Living donor kidney transplantation after living donor liver transplantation from the same donor in a patient with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease: a case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Saito Y, Yamamoto I, Kawabe M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：来自同一供体的序贯活体肝移植 (LDLT) 和活体肾移植 (LDKT) 极为罕见，全球报道的此类病例不到 10 例。 临床提示：这些手术提出了独特的手术、伦理和免疫学考虑。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Sequential living donor liver transplantation (LDLT) and living donor kidney transplantation (LDKT) from the same donor are extremely rare, with fewer than 10 such cases reported worldwide. These procedures present unique surgical, ethical, and immunological considerations. A 63-year-old man with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD) underwent LDLT from his wife for massive polycystic liver disease complicated by portal hypertension. Three years later, he received LDKT from the same donor following comprehensive evaluation for end-stage renal disease due to ADPKD. Pre-implantation kidney biopsy of the donor revealed thin basement membrane nephropathy with mild arteriosclerosis...

portal_hypertension.title: Liver Transplantation for Refractory Portal Hypertension Syndrome due to Intrahepatic Arterioportal Shunts Following Treatment of Primary Hepatic Choriocarcinoma: A Case Report.
portal_hypertension.journal: American journal of transplantation : official journal of the American Society of Transplantation and the American Society of Transplant Surgeons
portal_hypertension.authors: Medio P, Singer S, Della Penna A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：绒毛膜癌是一种恶性生殖细胞肿瘤，主要影响育龄妇女，被认为可以通过化疗高度治愈。 临床提示：原发性肝绒毛膜癌 (PHC) 极为罕见，并且发生时没有妊娠滋养细胞起源的证据。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Choriocarcinoma is a malignant germ cell tumor that predominantly affects women of reproductive age, considered highly curable with chemotherapy. Primary hepatic choriocarcinoma (PHC) is exceptionally rare and occurs without evidence of a gestational trophoblastic origin. We present an adult liver transplantation (LT) for intrahepatic arterioportal (AP) shunts that developed following treatment of PHC. A 34-year-old female presented with hepatosplenomegaly and upper abdominal pain four months after an uncomplicated pregnancy. Imaging revealed multiple large partially vascularized liver lesions, without extrahepatic disease. A CT-guided biopsy confirmed PHC. Initial serum human chorionic gona...
